recent_articles.rephrased_article: **China's** authorities are cracking down on "ghost kitchens", restaurants that operate without physical locations but appear on food delivery apps.  These businesses outsource orders to third-party vendors, leading to concerns about food safety and price manipulation. **The government** has ordered app platforms to verify restaurant licenses and addresses, while merchants must ensure online listings match their physical operations. The crackdown follows a series of investigations into "ghost kitchens" that revealed widespread use of forged business licenses and outsourcing practices.  Authorities have fined several e-commerce platforms for facilitating these arrangements.

recent_articles.title: Sabrina Carpenter gets restraining order against man who showed up at her home
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sabrina Carpenter**, a Grammy-winning pop star, has been granted a temporary restraining order against **William Applegate**.  Carpenter alleges that **Applegate** repeatedly trespassed onto her property in Los Angeles, attempted to force his way into her home, and made false claims about knowing her. The singer's lawyers claim the incidents have caused "significant and ongoing fear" for her safety. A follow-up hearing is scheduled for June 17th.

recent_articles.title: No dustbin, no business: Kurnool civic chief fines two shops on sanitation round - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kurnool Municipal Corporation (KMC) Commissioner Challa Obulesu** conducted sanitation inspections in various areas of the city, including the Old Bus Stand, Sunkesula Road, and N. R. Peta. **Obulesu** ordered fines on two shops for failing to install dustbins and warned that their trade licenses could be revoked if they continued neglecting sanitation efforts. He also expressed dissatisfaction over waste dumping on the main road and directed sanitation inspectors to coordinate and take up sanitation management.

recent_articles.title: Min Aung Hlaing: Why Myanmar president's India visit is being closely watched
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Min Aung Hlaing**, the Myanmar president, is on a five-day visit to India, meeting with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**. The talks focused on trade, connectivity, border security, and defense. This visit is significant as it marks his first foreign trip since taking office in April and comes amidst criticism of the military-backed government's election and ongoing civil war.  India, concerned about security along its northern border, seeks to stabilize Myanmar while also managing China's growing influence in the country.

recent_articles.title: Two people shot dead amid Kenya protests against US Ebola quarantine centre plan
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Two people were shot dead in Nanyuki, Kenya, during protests against the US plan to establish an Ebola isolation center at a military base.  **Patrick Wahome**, a community leader, stated that one of the victims was shot while returning home from his business. The circumstances surrounding the second victim's death are unclear. **President William Ruto** defended the plan, stating it was a mutual agreement with the US government and that Kenya had taken steps to protect its population.  The High Court has extended the suspension of the facility's opening pending further information disclosure.

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma Death Case: Key Witness Attacked, Allegedly By Samarth Singh's Friends
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A key witness in the Twisha Sharma death case, **Neeraj Dubey**, claims he was attacked by the accused husband's friends in Bhopal.  **Dubey** alleges that four or five men surrounded him and threatened him against testifying in court after he reported witnessing events related to the dowry harassment charges brought by **Sharma's** family. He has filed a complaint with the police, who are investigating the incident and attempting to identify the attackers from CCTV footage.

recent_articles.title: Trump's $1.8 Billion 'Weaponization' Payout Put On Hold After Backlash
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump's** nearly $1.8 billion victim compensation fund, aimed at compensating individuals who alleged government "weaponization," has been put on hold after facing opposition from **Republican senators**. The fund was halted due to concerns over payouts to January 6th Capitol attackers and a lack of support from the White House.  The Justice Department, under acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, is currently reviewing the situation, with some sources suggesting it may be permanently scrapped. Senate Majority Leader John Thune has called for the fund's termination while House Speaker Mike Johnson also participated in discussions about the matter.

recent_articles.title: Russian Strikes Rock Ukraine, Killing 9, Wounding Dozens
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Russian** missile and drone strikes across Ukraine on Tuesday resulted in the deaths of nine people and numerous injuries. **Kyiv** was hit by ballistic missiles, causing fires and power outages, while **Dnipro** and **Kharkiv** also experienced attacks that killed five and ten people respectively.  The **Ukrainian** president has called for allies to provide Patriot missile systems to counter Russia's escalating air strikes. The attacks come after **President Volodymyr Zelensky** warned of a "massive new strike" by **Russia**.

recent_articles.title: Woman assaulted by Dutch police at asylum centre speaks to Al Jazeera | Police | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Malak Mahmoud**, a heavily pregnant woman, spoke to **Al Jazeera** after being assaulted by Dutch police at an asylum center.  **Police in Zeist** issued a statement saying they are reviewing the use of force and have opened an investigation, but have not responded to **Al Jazeera’s** request for comment.

recent_articles.title: Security Concern For Twisha Sharma's Mother-In-Law As CBI Custody Ends Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Giribala Singh**, a former **Bhopal District and Sessions Judge**, is now an accused in the death of model Twisha Sharma. Her police remand ends soon, with the CBI yet to decide whether to seek judicial custody or an extension. Concerns arise about housing her in a regular jail due to her past handling of sensitive criminal cases involving hardened offenders. Prison authorities are expected to conduct a security assessment if judicial custody is ordered. The CBI is examining the defense put forward by Singh and her son, who deny allegations of assault and destruction of evidence.

recent_articles.title: Iowa shooting: Six people killed in domestic dispute, police say
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Muscatine Police Department** officials confirmed six deaths in a series of shootings that appeared to stem from a domestic dispute. The suspected shooter, **Ryan Willis McFarland**, 52, was found dead with a self-inflicted gunshot wound after leaving the scene of the initial shooting at a home where four victims were found deceased.  A further search led officers to two additional locations where two more victims were found dead, all believed to be family members of the suspect. The investigation is ongoing.
